market.question: Will the highest temperature in Sao Paulo be 26°C on April 30?

assessment.reasoning: AccuWeather/forecast for GRU on Apr 30 shows a high near 79°F (~26.1°C). 26°C is the modal forecast bin; adjacent 25/27 bins are also likely given typical 1-2°C forecast error. Market 0.18 looks too low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether observed high lands at 25 or 27 instead of 26
